stories.title: One chart shows the incredible reversal at American tech companies
stories.simple_summary: A major shift is happening at big tech companies in America, but the headline doesn't explain exactly what changed.
stories.why_it_matters: Without knowing the specific details, it's hard to say if this affects you — this is mostly financial news for investors to pay attention to.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence: Why firms are struggling to set prices
stories.simple_summary: Companies are having trouble figuring out what price to charge for AI tools and services.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use or might use AI tools for your business, prices may still be uncertain and could change as companies work out fair costs.

stories.title: After killer quarter, Palantir CEO Alex Karp calls AI industry ‘Marxist’
stories.simple_summary: Palantir, a big AI company, had a very profitable quarter but its CEO warned that some AI companies can't be trusted yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large businesses — it's a discussion among tech leaders about which companies to trust with sensitive work.

stories.title: Saline Co. Sheriff’s Office said AI was used to edit evidence photo after online backlash
stories.simple_summary: A sheriff's office admitted they used AI to edit a piece of evidence in a photo after people complained online.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious problem — it shows we need clear rules about when AI can be used with evidence, so innocent people aren't wrongly accused.

stories.title: AWS is helping vibe-coding startup Superblocks, and the implications are big
stories.simple_summary: Amazon's cloud service (AWS) is now letting a coding tool work within private company systems, making it easier to separate AI from apps.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software engineers and large companies — not something you need to think about unless you run a tech company.

stories.title: Design Arena creators raise $7.9 million to bring taste to AI models
stories.simple_summary: A company called Design Arena raised money because it helps AI systems learn good taste and style from human opinions.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and AI companies — it shows one way AI is improving, but no action needed on your part.

stories.title: Influencers draw backlash for attending OpenAI’s first luxury trip
stories.simple_summary: Popular social media personalities went on a trip sponsored by OpenAI, and people online criticized them for it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is entertainment and social media news — it doesn't affect your daily life or business.

stories.title: Apple finally fixed Siri. So why does it feel anticlimactic?
stories.simple_summary: Apple finally improved its Siri voice assistant with new AI abilities, but people aren't as excited about it as they might have been a year ago.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Apple devices, Siri should work better now — but it's less of a big deal since other AI assistants have already gotten good.

stories.title: Breakingviews - Big Tech’s circular AI trade grows too big to veil
stories.simple_summary: Big tech companies are increasingly trading money and data with each other in AI deals in ways that may not be fully transparent.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors watching for unfair business practices — nothing immediate for small business owners to act on.

stories.title: Europe’s AI labeling and transparency rules are now in effect
stories.simple_summary: Europe passed new rules that require companies to tell you when you're talking to an AI chatbot or looking at AI-created fake videos.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live or do business in Europe, companies must now be honest when they're using AI — this protects you from being tricked.

stories.title: Congress’ favorite AI tool? ChatGPT
stories.simple_summary: Members of Congress use ChatGPT (an AI tool) to help write memos, read legislation, and answer constituents.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is now a standard work tool even in government — it's becoming as normal as email.

stories.title: White House finalizes artificial intelligence oversight framework
stories.simple_summary: The White House created an official set of rules and guidelines for how AI should be overseen and managed.
stories.why_it_matters: This means the government is taking AI seriously and making official rules — over time, this could affect what AI tools you can use and how they work.
